question: Indian wrestlers won ____ medals in Commonwealth Games 2022.
solution: The correct answer is __**12**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Indian wrestlers delivered a historic performance at the **Commonwealth Games 2022**, clinching a total of **12 medals**. • The Indian wrestling contingent achieved a remarkable **100% success rate**, as every single one of the **12 wrestlers** who traveled to **Birmingham** returned with a medal. • The medal haul consisted of **6 Gold**, **1 Silver**, and **5 Bronze** medals, making wrestling the most successful sport for India at the **2022 Games**. • The wrestling events were held at the **Coventry Arena** over two days, specifically on **August 5 and August 6, 2022**. • India dominated the mat, particularly on the first day of the wrestling competition, where all six wrestlers in action won medals, including three golds.
